_options._note: Catalyst-confirmed momentum — NOT a chart-pattern strategy. Entry is decided entirely by the news-driven code path in src/orchestrator.py (_scan_news_catalyst_signals), which requires a live NewsOpportunity (HIGH magnitude + BULLISH + BOOST + confidence>=0.65, already computed by src.news.opportunity_scanner.OpportunityScanner) PLUS price-above-VWAP and 2x volume confirmation before it will ever synthesize a Signal. The entry_conditions below are deliberately impossible (RSI can never exceed 100) so this spec is inert if evaluated through the normal per-bar scan — it exists only to supply a validated stop_loss / target / exit_conditions definition that the news code path reuses via CompiledStrategy.compute_sl/compute_target, and that SmartExitTracker reuses for partial/BE/trail/reversal exit management, exactly like every other intraday strategy.
